purpose: Establish v0.6.2 versus current main whole-lifecycle baseline and screen static-page sharing on that same current main

fixed.cap: P for Fork; Fresh roots bounded by workers

order: rotate 4 cells; rotate baseline/current/pages order within each cell by round+cell, adjacent three-arm cohorts
controls: 2 children positive and1 wrong-seed per arm/mode:12 processes
boundary: first Start through last cleanup and image factory disposal; includes cold image creation once per pages process
metrics: root preparation and cold image cost
lifetime max RSS only; not held-child RSS
screen: descriptive fixed comparison; prior fixed-wave PASS not relabeled; new ordinary-lifecycle results including first Start/whole-suite/Fresh costs govern recommendation; no extra repeats to reach a threshold
limits: single Mac. No new owner tracing, tail exclusion, guest changes, canonical adoption, Ubuntu qualification or release. Ordinary mixed-lifecycle only; no fixed-wave equivalence claim.
